text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of computer science that helps machines understand human language. It allows computers to read and make sense of written text, which is called text understanding. NLP is also used in translation, so tools can quickly turn words from one language into another. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where a computer studies text to discover whether the writer feels positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology feels smarter and more helpful.
